lines.text: Tom Brightwell here. I wanted to join this call personally because Harbor Logistics is exactly the kind of customer we built Brightpath for.
Glad to have you, Tom. We've been impressed with the product but we need reassurance on a few commitments.
I personally guarantee we will deliver the premium support package with four-hour response time from day one of go-live.
What about admin training? Our team will need to be up to speed quickly.
We will run two admin training sessions within the first week after go-live, standard for all customers.
I'd like to know about CRM integration. We use Salesforce.
CRM sync with Salesforce is standard and we will have it live within three weeks of signing.
What about workflow automation? We have some complex approval chains.
We will configure up to ten custom workflows as part of standard onboarding, covered in the two-week window.
And accounting? We need everything to sync with our QuickBooks.
Accounting sync with QuickBooks is standard and included, we will complete that within fourteen days of signing.
We want to make sure all our users can log in via our company SSO. We mentioned SAML last time.
Confirmed, SAML single sign-on will be live within two weeks of signing, we need your IdP metadata to start.
We'll send the IdP metadata and test credentials by end of this week.
Can you do a custom dashboard for our ops team?
A fully custom dashboard is something I'd need to scope further, it's not in the standard package.
I can tell you that we're committed to making Harbor Logistics successful. If there are gaps, we'll find a way.
That's reassuring. What's the earliest we could go live if we sign next week?
If you sign by September 25th, we can target a go-live of November 9th, that's forty-five days.
We'd also like to explore whether you offer payroll system integration down the line.
Payroll integration is on the roadmap for next year, nothing I can commit to today.
Alright. Kim, any final questions?
No, I think we have what we need. We'll review internally and come back to you by Friday.
We look forward to it. We're excited about this partnership.
Thank you both. I'll send over the proposal summary after this call.
